fusions.name: Tablecloth Yank
fusions.desc: Yanks a tablecloth out from under everything in a 3-tile cone, dealing 11 damage and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sopped Clean
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. It consumes every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 damage plus their remaining damage, with 50% more for each affliction consumed, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Laid Table
fusions.desc: Spreads a laden tablecloth at your feet for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Let-Out Seams
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
